fusions.name: Leaf-Mould Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a spadeful of spore-thick leaf mould in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Morning Flush
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 15 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shallow Grave
fusions.desc: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles sprouts where it lies for 8 seconds, and gives every enemy within 4 tiles of it Rot for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Compost
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
